scope: read-only review of the sealed preparation, mesh comparer, and matched three-form summary helper

corrected_assessment.detail: geometry_mesh is assigned from base[source_prepared] before the refined branch. The branch reassigns only mesh and updates the electrical mesh/contact metadata.
corrected_assessment.detail_2: The h5py read uses geometry_mesh, so TetrahedralHeart, nominal_volume_ml, nominal_centre_m, and analytic state volumes remain based on the original base tetra union, including for refined L1 preparation.
corrected_assessment.denominator_consequence: The prior warning that L1 recomputed the analytic volume/centroid from refined tetrahedra is withdrawn. With the same base plan, the analytic denominator is shared exactly; the refined mesh changes query/electrical discretization only.

refined_branch: Original source hash is checked before the branch.
The refined export is checked against that original source and its prepared/contact hashes are bound in the plan.
Fine query tetrahedra are selected from the refined mesh, while the individual heart classifier receives the original TetrahedralHeart.
Baseline individual identity is checked against refined mesh tissue labels; exporter/refinement provenance carries inherited labels and parent-volume preservation checks.
mesh_comparison: Each coarse/fine pair requires the same geometry, parameterisation, deformation, frequency, rho, conductivity, 5 mm electrode model, ground, and physical contact id/areas/centres.
Fine refinement status, original source/contact hashes, prepared/contact artifacts, node/surface/contact flags, embedding error, matrix error, and artifact hashes are checked.
The denominator is 2*step*baseline_analytic_volume_ml; Sminus and Splus use the matching one-sided dV denominator.
The three-form helper requires complete five-state pairs at q=16384 and emits all geometry_qc rows.
The current three-form helper seals and compares candidate_parameters.json hashes across sphere/ellipsoid coarse/fine runs.

findings.finding: The intermediate ready status is written by the frozen stage before the thin wrapper appends its implementation hashes and rewrites plan.sha256.
findings.action: The stated monitored(wrapper) exit0 gate is sufficient; do not trigger assembly from the intermediate status file.

findings.finding: Geometry QC rows are included, but the current shape_errors metric list contains electrical Sminus/derivative/Splus only. Directional material slopes are not yet represented in that table.
findings.action: Add raw material Sminus=(M0-Mminus)/dV and Splus=(Mplus-M0)/dV with the same nominal-volume dV; report values without inventing an acceptance cutoff. Re-seal the helper hash afterward.

findings.location: fine refinement validation and state comparison
findings.finding: The comparer does not independently load and compare L0/L1 tissue label arrays. It relies on the sealed exporter/refinement record plus the preparation baseline identity check.
findings.action: Accept this for the current sealed chain only when the refinement report has passed inherited-label and per-parent-volume checks; keep original_geometric_source_sha256 and union_is_not_convex_hull visible in QC.

findings.finding: Cross-form checks explicitly cover source hashes, frequency, rho, conductivity, contact, electrode model, and nominal volume. They do not independently repeat ground_zero_based, deformation, parameter, or solver criteria across forms.
findings.action: No change is required when all forms are prepared from the same sealed base plan; if any form was prepared independently, verify these fields before interpreting shape errors.

limitations: One coarse/fine pair is a comparison and does not certify spatial convergence.
Directional electrical asymmetry is diagnostic; no physical cause is assigned.
The summary compares individual against sphere/ellipsoid at each mesh level; the pair comparer itself intentionally rejects different geometry values.
